CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  (Notice No. N2M21-141)
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events
Committee Meeting will be held on Wednesday January 19, 2022, commencing at 7:00 P.M. at
Alhambra City Hall 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California via video conference.
Consistent with AB 361, the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee meeting will not be
physically open to the public, although the public may participate by video conference or
teleconference and some of the Commission members may choose to participate via video
conference or teleconference rather than attend in person.
To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency
and public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Meeting as follows:
Zoom Meeting direct link:
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/86003696825?pwd=eHhwZDVhMzVWQll6WiswM3REb2s3dz09

Webinar ID: 860 0369 6825 Passcode: 361243
Or by telephone by dialing 877 853 5257 US Toll-free, 888 475 4499 US Toll-free, 833 548 0276 US
Toll-free, 833 548 0282 US Toll-free and entering Webinar ID: 860 0369 6825 and Passcode:
361243. Please note: All members of the public calling or logging into the meeting will be muted so
that the meeting can proceed.
For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Kelsey Rivadeneyra at
kelsey@cityofalhambra.org prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and your
name. You should then join into the meeting 10 minutes prior to its start time. Ms. Rivadeneyra will
announce to you when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is
adjusted by the President.
As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to kelsey@cityofalhambra.org no
later than 5:00 P.M. on January 19, 2022 to ensure that it will be printed prior to the beginning of the
meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per
individual comment, subject to the President’s discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 P.M. but
before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a
part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
e-mail or call Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5044 who will use their
best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of video conference meetings, all participants are
encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.
  KELSEY RIVADENEYRA

  CLERICAL ASSISTANT II

Dated: January 13, 2022

minutes_text:
Unofficial until adopted by the  February 16, 2021
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, January 19, 2021
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at 7:05
P.M. on Wednesday, January 19, 2021, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street Alhambra,
via Video Conference Zoom.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: Vice President Sanchez, Commission Member Arambula,
Commission Member Hermano, and Commission Member Jimenez.
Committee Members Absent: President Canseco-Chan.
Also attending: Director Michael Macias and Deputy Director Brie Houghton.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES FROM THE DECEMBER 15, 2021 C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Sanchez and a second by Commission Member Arambula the
December 15, 2021 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting minutes were approved
with the change of updating Maria Jimenez presence.

ALHAMBRA ART ALLEY PROJECT
Commission Member Arambula proposed a mural with a historical theme for a future portion of
the city that will be known as “Old Town” or a large art piece that could tie in with the Alhambra
Historical Museum. Commission Members Jimenez and Arambula agreed and recommend to
create a criterion for public art that is in alignment with the Alhambra Art Survey results.
Commission Member Jimenez Vice President Sanchez suggested the parking structures off of
Main Street as a possible public art location.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton invited the commission to the Winter Around the World community
event that will honor and celebrate winter holidays from different countries as well as the spring
2022 Mad Hatter Tea Party at Almansor Park.

The City Arts and Cultural Events Commission requested further clarification on Katrina
Williams’ lobby art exhibition packet before issuing an approval or denial. Deputy Director
Houghton will contact Ms. Williams for clarification on her art pieces and agreed to pitch artist
interviews and soundbites to management.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.
 COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
None.

ADJOURNMENT
Vice President Sanchez moved to adjourn the January 19, 2021 City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission Meeting. With a motion by Commission Member Arambula and seconded by
Commission Member Jimenez, the meeting was adjourned at 8:04 P.M.
